​精子を作る細胞にも「生まれなかった双子」のDNAが含まれていたため、「遺伝学的には、生まれていない叔父が父親になった」という信じられない奇跡が起きたのです。

snippet.title: Віцепрезидентка Європарламенту ОГОЛОСИЛА ГОЛОДУВАННЯ, щоб привернути увагу до ОЛЕШОК
snippet.description:
Віцепрезидентка Європейського парламенту Піна Пічерно оголосила голодування, щоб привернути увагу світу до критичної гуманітарної ситуації в окупованому місті Олешки на Херсонщині. Повідомлення про своє рішення вона розмістила в соцмережі. «В Україні, в Олешках, тисячі людей опинилися в пастці на території, окупованій російською армією, без постійного доступу до їжі та ліків. Заміновані території роблять втечу надзвичайно небезпечною: ті, хто залишається, ризикують померти від голоду, а ті, хто намагається вибратися, — ризикують своїм життям», — зазначила вона.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

snippet.title: History of How Sir Syed Built Aligarh Muslim University ✨#amu #aligarhmuslimuniversity #sirsyedday
snippet.description:
The Story of How Sir Syed Ahmad Khan Built AMU | Aligarh Muslim University | Sir Syed Day Special 🎓

How did Sir Syed Ahmad Khan build the vision that eventually became Aligarh Muslim University (AMU)? What were the struggles behind the making of one of India’s most historic universities? And how did a small beginning with just 11 students in 1875 eventually become Aligarh Muslim University in 1920?

In this Sir Syed Day Special AMU vlog, I take you through the remarkable story of Sir Syed Ahmad Khan, Aligarh Muslim University, Aligarh and the Aligarh Movement — and the determination, fundraising, education reform and vision that went into building this institution.

The history of AMU Aligarh is deeply connected with Sir Syed Ahmad Khan’s dream of bringing modern education, science, English and intellectual development together with Deen, culture and a strong sense of identity. After travelling to England in 1869 and observing the educational environment of institutions such as Oxford and Cambridge, Sir Syed became even more convinced about the importance of modern education for the future of Indian Muslims.

But turning that vision into reality was far from easy.

Sir Syed Ahmad Khan had to convince people to invest in education at a time when modern education was not accessible to everyone and his ideas were not always easily accepted. He wrote letters, travelled, met influential people, approached donors, raised funds and encouraged ordinary people to contribute according to their means. The making of AMU was therefore not simply the story of one building or one benefactor — it was the story of a wider educational movement.

The journey began with Madrasatul Uloom / Madrasatul Uloom Aligarh in 1875. The institution began with just 11 students, eventually developing into the Muhammadan Anglo Oriental College (MAO College), also known as MAO College Aligarh. Decades later, in 1920, it became Aligarh Muslim University.

This story is also the story of the Aligarh Movement, one of the most significant educational and intellectual movements in the history of Muslims in India. Sir Syed Ahmad Khan’s educational movement played an important role in encouraging modern education, scientific thinking and intellectual development.

snippet.title: 3 Reasons why your bends FAIL
snippet.description:
This flange is too short for the press brake to grab. Do you check flange length before you send a part out?

A short flange has nothing to rest on, so it slips into the V and the bend comes out wrong. 

Keep holes back from the bend line, or a round hole stretches into an oval.

Add a small relief notch where a bend meets a flat edge so the corner doesn't tear or bulge. 

Send this to a designer who could use the help, and order parts at fabworks.com.

No Conversa Sem Curva, a educadora e sindicalista Elenira Vilela faz um diagnóstico contundente sobre as reais motivações por trás da candidatura de Flávio Bolsonaro. Elenira aponta que o projeto político possui dois sentidos centrais: o primeiro é garantir a anistia para criminosos condenados, além de blindar o candidato e seus aliados contra o avanço de investigações atualmente abertas.

O segundo ponto destacado pela analista é a ameaça direta à soberania nacional e aos recursos do país. Elenira alerta que a consolidação desse grupo no poder representaria uma agenda profunda de submissão e entreguismo \("BolsoTrump"\), comprometendo o futuro do Brasil. Para a convidada, compreender essa estrutura é fundamental para defender a democracia e proteger as instituições no processo eleitoral.
